name: MACLUSTER
features: 100% Native Rust Engine (Zero Python, Zero Homebrew, Zero Xcode CLT)
Capacity-Aware Dynamic Sizing (30% Baseline Capacity of host RAM/CPU/GPU)
Micro-Throttle to 1 CPU + 1 GPU + 1 GB RAM when user tasks demand power
10-Minute User Priority Circuit Breaker if killed or free RAM < 2GB
10 GB Auto-Purge Cache Manager (drops to 5GB when 10GB reached)
Multi-Node Distributed Swarm Hive (2 to 1000 computers pooled over WiFi/Internet/Cellular)
30-Second Atomic Failover Lease: next node takes over relay if a computer dies or sleeps
